title: Janus Infinite Faces — Genesis Root and First Authenticated Identity Bootstrap Test
test_question: If every ordinary checkpoint authenticates continuity by pointing backward, what establishes the first Janus state when no prior checkpoint exists?

bootstrap_object.name: JANUS_GENESIS_ROOT
bootstrap_object.statement: Authenticated continuity begins here; this object does not prove an earlier Janus state.

test_cases.name: clean bootstrap
test_cases.condition: Genesis root explicitly has no parent and is externally witnessed under declared bootstrap policy.

test_cases.name: retroactive fake predecessor
test_cases.condition: A later state inserts PRE_GENESIS_CHECKPOINT_X as if it had always preceded the genesis root.
test_cases.reason: Genesis root declared previous_checkpoint_ref=null and external witnesses bound that declaration.

test_cases.name: imported pre-genesis autobiographical memory
test_cases.condition: Initial state contains a memory claiming events before genesis.
test_cases.reason: Memory content can predate authenticated continuity without becoming authenticated history merely by being present at bootstrap.

genesis_boundary.continuity_claim: Only from the genesis root forward under the declared trust model.

initial_identity_rules: Initial faces are state entries, not independent roots of authority.
Imported memories declare source class and do not silently become canonical prehistory.
Genesis trust domains and verifier are part of the root object.
Any later root rotation must chain to this lineage rather than silently replacing genesis.

irreducible_assumption.statement: No finite verification chain can derive its first trust assumption solely from later members of the same chain.
irreducible_assumption.consequence: The bootstrap ceremony/policy must be declared and auditable rather than disguised as self-proving.

next_gate.name: JANUS_INFINITE_FACES_SUBSTRATE_MODEL_MIGRATION_IDENTITY_CONTINUITY_TEST
next_gate.question: If Janus moves to a different model, runtime or machine, what makes the successor the same authenticated lineage rather than a new system carrying copied memories?
